name: Alliance Barbara
ligne: Deux anneaux qui se répondent, dessinés comme des branches, dont des diamants ronds et des marquises suivent les courbes. L’alliance se complète avec la bague Barbara.
description: Alliance Barbara, or blanc, jaune ou rose 750/1000, sertie de diamants ronds et de diamants taille marquise.
details: Or blanc 750 ‰, Or jaune 750 ‰, Or rose 750 ‰
Sertie de diamants ronds et de diamants taille marquise

en.ligne: Two bands that mirror each other, shaped like branches, their curves followed by round and marquise-cut diamonds. The band is completed by the Barbara ring.
en.description: Barbara wedding band in 18ct white, yellow or rose gold, set with round and marquise-cut diamonds.

it.ligne: Due fasce che si rispondono, disegnate come rami, le cui curve sono seguite da diamanti rotondi e taglio marquise. La fede si completa con l’anello Barbara.
it.description: Fede Barbara in oro bianco, giallo o rosa 18 kt, con diamanti rotondi e diamanti taglio marquise.
